'''Chapter 542''' is titled "Another Incident to Be Told".

==Cover Page==
[[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and Animals: [[Karoo]] takes a dog out for a walk.

==Short Summary==
[[Impel Down]] was in chaos, with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and some prisoners on Level 4, [[Buggy]] and prisoners on Level 2, and the [[Blackbeard Pirates]] at the main entrance. Meanwhile, [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] was on his way to his execution.

==Long Summary==
As [[Vice Admiral]] [[Onigumo]] escorts [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] to [[Marineford]], he is informed that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is leading a riot in [[Impel Down]]. Meanwhile, at Marineford, a panicked soldier informs Fleet Admiral [[Sengoku]] of [[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]]'s mysterious disappearance, a shocking event considering the danger of [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s imminent attack. He also tells Sengoku about a mysterious marine vessel with no deployment authorization that has arrived at Impel Down.

At the great prison, Impel Down, Blackbeard and his crew arrive and quickly defeat a group of jailers, claiming that they are on the same side. The rest of the facility is warned of Blackbeard's betrayal, and the [[pirate]]s proceed into the prison.

Due to these events combined with the riots, Vice Warden [[Hannyabal]] is beginning to panic and suggests that he and some jailers escape, but [[Magellan]] contacts him, revealing that the riot on Level 2 has been stopped by sealing the entrances and exits. Magellan tells Hannyabal to stall on Level 4 until he arrives. Meanwhile, on Level 6, former chief [[Shiryu]] is being let out of his cell in order to help the situation. He is warned by Magellan that there will be no second chances, and is told to go after Blackbeard. As soon as the transmission is stopped, Shiryu slaughters several guards with his [[Raiu|newly reunited blade]], apologizing for his actions.

On Level 4, Luffy and his group are fighting their way through the guards, releasing many prisoners as they go. Chief Guard [[Saldeath]] attacks with his [[Animal Species/Summit War Saga#Blue Gorilla|Blue Gorillas]], but [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]] beats them back. As they proceed, they find the path blocked by [[Sadi]] and the three Jailer Beasts. Many of their forces are defeated, but Luffy, [[Crocodile]], and [[Jinbe]] defeat the three beasts with their individual attacks.
